issue: Written proof had d=0⇒leastN4 but used leastN4⇒d=0 without an explicit local argument
mechanism: Opposite next normal negates both RHS cosines in identity5; add equal positive-support left sides
only_inserted_paragraph: Conversely, if the least period is4, antipodal pairing gives n_2=-n_0 and h_2=h_0. Apply (5) to (n_0,n_1) and (n_1,n_2). The cosine of the normal difference and the cosine of the normal sum both change sign, while the left side in each identity is d h_0 h_1. Adding the two identities gives 2d h_0 h_1=0. Since the support numbers are positive, d=0. Thus the four-period case and d=0 coincide.
